snippet.title: 🎮 MONGIL: STAR DIVE ❌ Summer Game Fest 2025 🎮
snippet.description:
🎮 MONGIL: STAR DIVE ❌ Summer Game Fest 2025 🎮

DIVE into a world of wonder!
📢 Adventurers, attention please! We’ve got important news!

🔥 MONGIL: STAR DIVE will officially participate in the Summer Game Fest 2025 🔥
held in Los Angeles on Saturday, June 7th! 🎉

Set in a world where monsters, humans, and demihumans coexist,
you’ll collect adorable monsters and experience a unique tag battle system
with a cast of charming and diverse characters—
MONGIL: STAR DIVE is ready to shine on the global stage! 🌍

Curious to dive into the sparkling unknown world of MONGIL: STAR DIVE? 👀
Perfect timing! We are now recruiting Mongillers to join our closed beta test!

Apply now via the link below! 📝

▶ Apply now to become a Mongiller!
https://stardive.netmarble.com/mongillers

Dive with us into a world of wonder!
Please continue to show your love and support for MONGIL: STAR DIVE! 💙

#SummerGameFest #MongilStarDive #Mongil #MongilSTARDIVE #MonsterTaming #Monster #Netmarble #ActionRPG #Game #EpicStore
